title: Standards Compliance
description: MUST comply with industry standards for text-to-video generation.

title: Hardware Limitations
description: SHOULD be designed to handle high GPU-intensive processes.

title: Performance
description: SHOULD be able to generate videos in a reasonable amount of time.

title: User Experience
description: SHOULD provide a user-friendly interface for users to interact with the system.

title: Scalability
description: MAY be designed to handle a large number of users and video requests.
